text:
Alex: FYI PR #8450 landed into canary ~2h ago. Quick perf run against our longseq 4k suite shows p95 up ~12% and memory p95 +~180MB. Holding final merge until we get 2 approvals and a perf signoff. @Mira @Sam can you take a quick look?

ci-bot: Bench artifacts uploaded -> https://ci.redwood/bench/8450/run-2026-03-17. Summary in artifact: p95 420ms -> 470ms (+12%), p99 880ms -> 910ms (+3.4%), mem p95 1.20GB -> 1.38GB (+180MB). Throughput steady-ish, tail is the main hit.

Mira: I'll grab the heatmap and skim the diff. Which config changed in this PR? microbatching or eviction?

Alex: Main changes: adjusted batch-horizon calc and a tweak to prefill aggressiveness + small kv-evict heuristic. I added inline comments in the PR pointing to the two spots.

Sam: I'll run the same microbench locally with the exact seed and config used by CI. Ping me ~20m.

David: Quick question — did we enable any quant-fallback path in this PR? wondering if fallback churn could explain the tail.

Alex: No quant changes here, this is scheduler + prefill. Quant kernel path untouched.

Jen: If we end up rolling back, heads-up: infra prefers rollback window 18:30-19:00 UTC to minimize capacity re-assignment churn. If we hotfix, schedule after that window.

Sam: local run done, numbers line up but smaller delta: p95 +9%, mem +170MB. Paste: ```
bench summary
model: redwood-2-small
seq: 4096
p95_before: 420ms
p95_after: 458ms
mem_p95_before: 1.20GB
mem_p95_after: 1.38GB
throughput: 95r/s -> 93r/s
```

Mira: Looking at the scheduler change now — lines ~120-140. The batch horizon formula got tightened (multiplier 0.75 -> 0.9) which increases prefill frequency. That can raise contention for KV cache and raise mem pressure. I'll post a suggested revert for just that calc and keep the other heuristic.

Alex: Great. If Mira + Sam can approve the tiny revert by EOD, we'll ship a hotfix at 20:00 UTC (outside infra rollback window). If not, we'll rollback the whole PR and open a follow-up. @oncall for visibility.

ci-bot: perf-tests/longseq: all checks green except throughput-run-3 shows a 4% variance flagged as non-blocking. Artifacts linked above.

Sam: leaving approval once Mira's revert PR looks right. Thanks everyone.
